about: 40 proof-to-criterion pairs for the vector search (K3): each proof is a short evidence summary as an inbound message would carry it, labelled with the one milestone of its brief it proves. Proofs are written in their own words, not copied from the milestone text. Top-2 hit rate: the labelled milestone is among the 2 nearest criteria of the proof's own brief.
